policy_source: run bal-1, checkpoint balance_task.000400.cxpolicy, declared by the product agent as robin-balance-1.cxpolicy
spec_sha256_rule: sha256 of the evaluation report's spec block as canonical JSON (sorted keys, no spaces); the confirmation's spec must hash to this, which is the spec bal-1's round evaluation held and which the product agent wrote from the frozen contract byte for byte

conditions.goal: none: hold the position and heading of the first timed frame

predicates.name: completes
predicates.rule: runs the full 10.0 s and ends by truncation; no termination fires

predicates.name: stays_in_place
predicates.metric: largest plan distance of the base point from its position in the first timed frame, in COM heights

predicates.name: keeps_heading
predicates.metric: max abs heading_deg over every frame

predicates.name: recovers
predicates.metric: time from the end of each shove to the first frame that starts 1.0 s of rest

pass_rule: A policy passes a behaviour only if every one of the ten seeds passes every predicate. No per-seed rate is granted to any behaviour. One failed seed fails the policy; results are never averaged across seeds, and all ten are reported.
void_rule: a seed is void, and not a result, if its model digest is not the model read, it carries no policy digest, its drawn conditions are not the contract's for that seed, its frames are not one per control step or the rate is under 50 Hz, or its episode raised a solver warning
verdict_rule: R3's confirmation passes only if the evaluation verdict is pass with every one of the ten seeds passing B1-B5 and none void, AND every judged seed (1101, 1105, 1110) meets the bar (median total >= 9 of 12, no trait median below 2). A judge call that is not a score (refusal, harness error, wrong model) is not a verdict: it is retried as a harness failure, not counted. Where the judge contradicts a measured predicate the predicate wins and the disagreement is recorded (ADR-463); a judged seed that misses the bar still fails the confirmation, and is diagnosed before any retraining.
commands: pixi run python docs/probes/ot11/runner/judge.py balance --evaluation ot11-robin-1/evaluations/r3-confirm-1 --seed S --label r3-confirm-1 --out docs/probes/ot11/retained/judge-r3-confirm-1-seed-S.json   (S = 1101, 1105, 1110)
film: detail sheet from the first shove's onset, 0.2 s apart (the evaluate default, which is the contract's balance detail)
no_fishing: This confirmation is run once. A second R3 confirmation needs a recorded product change between the two.
earlier_evaluation: evaluations/cbf14e3c6865-8919a22dae1f (bal-1's training-round evaluation, a loop round, not a confirmation)
